name: Overlogging
detailed_description:
Overlogging – Master the Timber Industry

Step into the rugged world of logging and lumber management in Overlogging, the ultimate simulation game for forestry enthusiasts! Take control of a thriving lumberyard, operate powerful heavy machinery, and oversee every step of the logging process—from felling trees to exporting high-quality timber worldwide.

Key Features:

🪵 Run Your Own Lumber Empire – Manage resources, optimize production, and expand your operations to dominate the timber industry.

🚜 Operate Heavy Machinery – Use equipment like feller bunchers, skidders, loaders, and sawmills to process and transport logs efficiently.

🌲 Explore Expansive Forests – Harvest a variety of tree species, each with unique properties and market demand.

🚛 Logistics & Transportation – Plan export routes, load up trucks and trains, and ensure smooth deliveries to maximize profits.

🏗️ Upgrade & Expand – Invest in new machines, hire workers, and upgrade your facility to handle larger operations.

🔥 Dynamic Market System – Prices fluctuate based on supply, demand, and global trends—strategize to get the best deals.

Can you build a logging empire while keeping up with the demands of the industry? Or will you find yourself… Overlogging?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: HDD supported, but SSD recommended for smoother performance
